name: microsoft_book-meeting-room
description: Add a meeting room to an existing calendar event. Adds room as resource attendee and updates event location. IMPORTANT: Always check availability first using check-room-availability to prevent double-bookings.

eventId.description: Calendar event ID (obtained from list-events or create-event)

roomEmail.description: Room email address to book (obtained from list-meeting-rooms)

roomName.description: Room display name (optional, used for location field). If not provided, roomEmail is used.

updateLocation.description: Whether to update the event location field with room name (default: true)

verifyAvailability.description: Whether to check room availability before booking (default: true). Set to false only if you've already verified availability.

success.description: true if room was successfully booked

roomBooked.description: Room email address that was booked

eventWebLink.description: Web link to view the updated event in Outlook

errors.description: Room is not available during the meeting time (only if verifyAvailability=true)
errors.message: Room is not available during the meeting time. Please check availability or choose a different room.

errors.description: Room is already booked for this meeting
errors.message: Room is already booked for this meeting.
Calendar event not found. Please verify the event ID.
Missing required permission: Calendars.ReadWrite. Please re-authenticate with proper permissions.

examples.description: Book a room to an existing meeting with availability check
Book a room without updating location field
